name: Owen Scott Muir
role: Psychiatrist; Chief Medical Officer, Radial; author of The Frontier Psychiatrists
bio: Child, adolescent and adult psychiatrist. Co-founded Fermata, an interventional psychiatry clinic in Brooklyn, then joined Radial as Chief Medical Officer; also works with Neurolief. Writes The Frontier Psychiatrists on Substack (1,126 posts since May 2021) on interventional psychiatry, psychedelics, payers and health policy.

coverage.corpus: The full archive of The Frontier Psychiatrists on Substack, every post from 2021-05-06 to 2026-09-11, free and paid, read in full through the Substack API (free) and the subscriber session (paid). Restacks of other authors are excluded.

name: Christian Angermayer
role: Founder, Apeiron Investment Group; co-founder and chairman, atai Life Sciences; early Compass Pathways investor
bio: German investor. Seed investor and long-time large shareholder in Compass Pathways (COMP360 psilocybin); co-founded atai Life Sciences in 2018, which merged with Beckley Psytech in 2025 and agreed to be acquired by Eli Lilly in July 2026. Speaks on X, LinkedIn, Substack, conferences and podcasts.

name: Rick Doblin
role: Founder and president, MAPS; founder of MAPS PBC (later Lykos Therapeutics)
bio: Founded the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies in 1986 and led it for decades. Founded MAPS Public Benefit Corporation, renamed Lykos Therapeutics in 2024, which received a complete response letter for MDMA-assisted therapy in August 2024; left the Lykos board afterwards. Speaks in MAPS bulletins, conferences and podcasts.
